controls.name: create-marks-asserted
controls.find: Rows { f: |u: T| if u == t && !present(e, t) { Some(false) } else { (e.f)(u) } }
controls.replace: Rows { f: |u: T| if u == t { Some(false) } else { (e.f)(u) } }
controls.classification: decision: a create of an existing inferred triple makes it asserted (the repair)

controls.name: derive-lifts-domain
controls.find:
|| (t.1 == TYPE() && exists|p: int, s: int| !reserved(p) && arow(e, (p, RNG(), t.2)) && arow(e, (s, p, t.0)))

controls.name: retract-everything
controls.find: pub open spec fn retract(e: Rows) -> Rows { Rows { f: |t: T| if arow(e, t) { Some(false) } else { None } } }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn retract(e: Rows) -> Rows { Rows { f: |t: T| None } }
controls.classification: effect: retract deletes asserted rows too

controls.name: materialize-overwrites
controls.find: Rows { f: |t: T| if present(e, t) { (e.f)(t) } else if derives(e, t) { Some(true) } else { None } }
controls.replace: Rows { f: |t: T| if derives(e, t) { Some(true) } else if present(e, t) { (e.f)(t) } else { None } }
controls.classification: effect: materialize marks an asserted triple inferred
